notes: Fields map 1:1 onto the legacy pgAdmin dialog (workflow legacy_preserved): field ids are the BaseUISchema ids and are served by the existing SQL templates. Source: web/pgadmin/browser/server_groups/servers/roles/static/js/role.ui.js (RoleSchema), static/js/membership.ui.js, static/js/variable.ui.js (keys name/value/database), static/js/sec_label.ui.js. pgAdmin groups: General/Definition->General, Privileges->Privileges, Membership->Membership; Parameters and Security have no canonical tab on the role family and sit on the Engine tab. Whole-form readOnly (user lacks superuser / createrole and is not editing itself) is a provider authorisation rule, not a field rule. Field ids are checked against the pgAdmin *.ui.js schema ids by tools/tests/test_ui_descriptor_postgresql_schema_ids.py (the schema id gate); the form stays draft until phase 5 routes it to the SQL templates and ports the ui.spec expectations. Status complete (2026-11-11): create, alter and drop round-trip on PostgreSQL 18.3 through tools/tests/test_ui_descriptor_operations_postgresql.py; every field id is admitted by the provider form. Deliberate differences from the inherited dialog: a plan never carries a password (the field is refused); memberships and parameters are stated and removed through the Revoke and Reset grids rather than diffed; the INHERIT and SET membership columns compile to the PostgreSQL 16 WITH list; the account expiry is typed text.
